title: Logarithmic counting control states
statement: For each natural number $E$, introduce a finite set of control states for a counting procedure. Its states represent the setup and logarithm calculation, parameterized rounds and doubling, counting and nested enumeration stages, acceptance or rejection, and a walk through a sequence of configurations; states within a round carry a Boolean phase and an index among $0,\ldots,E$. The walk states carry Boolean flags as indicated by their roles, including whether to query an initial-code or step decider, compare against a target or bound, and count a step.
